epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斑馬為何有斑紋?企鵝如何在水底看東西?為何樹蛙的眼睛是紅色的?在可見的探索中,發掘一些動物如何進化以達到極佳的視力,而另一些卻進化至幾乎隱形。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Why do zebras have stripes? How do penguins see underwater? And why are a tree frog’s eyes red? In this exploration of sight, discover how some animals have evolved to see extremely well while others have evolved to be nearly invisible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯尼亞的捕獲隊伍前往索馬里邊境捕獲50隻被稱為亨氏牛羚的珍稀瀕危羚羊。在過去十年中,亨氏牛羚的數量一直急劇下降,保育組織知道通過捕獲並將它們置於受保護的零捕獵者保育區,有助數量回升。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Capture teams from Kenya head to Somali border to capture 50 rare and endangered antelope called a hirola. The hirola numbers have been plummeting over the last decade, and conservation groups know that by capturing and placing them into a protected predator-free conservancy they will rebound.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中。牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群勇敢的雄性企鵝聚集在水邊,準備在岸上進行危險的旅程。面對前路的險途,數量多比較安全。這些小企鵝有著重要的任務,繁殖的時候到了,牠們必須在雌性到來前找到一個洞穴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the water’s edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. It’s time to breed and they must find a burrow before the females arrive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭的西岸不像世上任何地方。從冰川覆蓋的山脈到原始雨林,再到嚴酷的寒冷海域,壯麗景致令人難以置信。這片與世隔絕幾乎未被觸及的桃花園,隱藏著許多土生的動物。進化的漂流者,每一個都是罕見的生態瑰寶。從啄羊鸚鵡和害羞的企鵝到哺乳類般的鷸鴕和古老的鰻魚,為了於這種條件下生存,這裡的野生動物必須堅強,狡猾和足智多謀。沿著西岸的旅程讓你窺見這片美地,以及生活在這裡的野生動物的考驗和磨難。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New Zealand’s West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭有兩個野生堡壘保護脆弱的土生動物: 一個是受到鹽水護城河保護的偏遠島嶼,另一個是被防捕食者屏障包圍的山頂城堡。這是這些精緻的庇護所和在其中茁壯成長的動物的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries and the life that thrives within them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭東岸的春天是紐西蘭海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好時光。牠們已回到自己的土地準備繁殖。但因惡劣的地形、無常的天氣和飢餓的掠食者使牠們的生活變得困難。只有最強者才能生存下去,並薪火相傳下去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring on New Zealand’s east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. They’ve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives difficult for them. Only the strongest will survive to carry forward their legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭與世隔絕的島嶼是不凡的天堂及家園,以擁有多元又獨特的野生動物聞名。尤以不會飛的鳥類、古代爬行類和沿海哺乳類最為人所共知,仔細觀察將會發現另一個世界。這裡有微型的怪物、小型的掠奪者和微小的恐怖,卻帶來了非凡的生命。每個獵人也是獵物﹐永遠需要努力生存。走進灌木叢,又會發現不同規模的生活。從巨型肉食蜈蚣和夜行蟋蟀到捕魚蛛和使用絲質陷阱的發光蠕蟲。奇怪而奇妙,這些無名英雄是野性紐西蘭最令人毛骨悚然的爬行類。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New Zealand’s isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand’s Creepiest Crawlies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個王國都需要一個傳位制度,生兒育女,是每個物種的生存之道。在某些社交圈,需要一整條村子來維繫家庭,但又有些只有單親父母能在野外的威脅中保護幼兒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies – and raising them – is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability of youth and the threats of the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古至今,很多物種都被絕種危機所威脅。就如強極一時的恐龍帝國,亦在地球上消失殆盡。但另外一些則從滅絕邊緣生存下來,慢慢恢復甚至在自然界中建立王國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires – like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounced back, and even reclaimed their kingdoms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場中的禽畜多是眾多歌曲和故事的主角,牠們在全球各地歡慶,但卻很少談起牠們在野外的兄弟姊妹物種。這些主要被稱為牲畜、負軛的野獸,甚至寵物,必須在其家養親屬的圍欄外自生自滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild. These animals known primarily as livestock, beasts of burden, or even pets must fend for themselves beyond the fences of their domesticated kin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 不速之客以量取勝,獲取領地,有些動物群被列為「害蟲」,但牠們若要生存,就是要找到不歡迎牠們的安身之所。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered “pests.” But their very survival may depend on finding a home where they’re not welcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人多好辦事,放諸野外同樣適用。這就是眾多物種都選擇群居的原因。保護族群才能賴以生存。對於這些動物,保護代表隔離 - 從外界的威脅中找到庇護所。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There’s strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it’s the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物之間的睡眠策略千變萬化,然而睡眠似乎是一種再普遍不過的行為。但究竟為何動物需要睡眠呢?它們如何應對無法休息或在野外昏迷可能帶來的危險?這些問題只是《野生動物如何睡覺》中的冰山一角。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕。冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配。一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒。大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子。三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季。跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantic’s intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存。被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己。馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里。每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondie’s love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on July’s salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜。看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母。為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油。挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物之間的睡眠策略千變萬化,然而睡眠似乎是一種再普遍不過的行為。但究竟為何動物需要睡眠呢?它們如何應對無法休息或在野外昏迷可能帶來的危險?這些問題只是《野生動物如何睡覺》中的冰山一角。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與那些用力量征服敵人的獸王一起變得更強。海獅為贏得配偶而使出渾身解數、非洲水牛使出致命一擊、加拿大鵝用翅膀的猛烈撞擊以及母獅用鐵爪統治草原的景象將讓你驚歎不已。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Power-up with alphas who use might to subdue enemies. Marvel when sea lions throw their weight around to win a mate, Cape buffalo deliver knockout punches, Canada geese hit hard with their wings, and lionesses rule the savannah with an iron paw.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯雅不斷增長的人口正從野生動植物手上奪取土地和資源。擠擁正造成越來越多人與動物間的衝突,這是非洲保育最大問題之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kenyas growing human population is taking land and resources away from wildlife. The squeeze is creating increasing numbers of conflicts between humans and animals, and is one of the biggest issues in African conservation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,動物收容所的一隻小狗幫助被帶回的小獵豹為回到野外做準備,一隻受傷的猴子贏得一群冷漠狗隻的歡心,還有一隻喜歡與一群羊一起覓食孤獨的獴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集《動物朋友仔》有一群急救中心的猴子,收養了一群小流浪貓;一頭忠心的狗幫助一隻浣熊克服她的恐懼;還有愛爾蘭雪達犬們養育了一隻鴯鶓。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多《動物朋友仔》,包括「牧場經理」巴克萊,一頭恰巧是馴馬天才的大丹犬。在非洲,一隻名為「雷神」的小狨猴迷戀兩隻年青獲救的獴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including “ranch manager” Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與伊恩·華納一同探索愛爾蘭荒野島嶼 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Irelands Wild Islands with Eoin Warner 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從拉斯林島開始,不會飛的海鸠雌鳥躍躍欲試,金色的野兔迎接黎明的到來。前往托里看看姥鯊、海豚和瀕臨滅絕的長腳秧雞的愛情之舞。隨後在阿基爾島追逐可愛的愛爾蘭白鼬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Begin on Rathlin, where flightless guillemot chicks take a leap of faith and golden hares welcome the dawn. Head to Tory to see basking sharks, dolphins, and the endangered corncrake’s dance of love. Then chase adorable Irish stoats across Achill.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與伊恩·華納一同探索愛爾蘭荒野島嶼 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Irelands Wild Islands with Eoin Warner 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著愛爾蘭西海岸繼續冒險之旅。在伊尼什凱亞群島窺探灰海豹的愛情故事,在康尼馬拉碧綠的海水中暢遊。漫步在克萊爾的神奇森林中,捕捉到數百條正在交配的姥鯊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continue the odyssey along Ireland’s west coast. Spy on the love affairs of grey seals in the Inishkea Islands and ply Connemara’s turquoise waters. Wander in Clare’s magical woods and catch hundreds of basking sharks engaged in a mating display.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與伊恩·華納一同探索愛爾蘭荒野島嶼 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Irelands Wild Islands with Eoin Warner 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解北極燕鷗如何途徑5萬英里的路途抵達凱里的馬哈里群島避暑。在布蘭登岬附近觀賞鯨魚,然後目睹愛爾蘭最壯觀的野生動物奇觀: 大布拉斯科特島上的1000隻灰海豹棲息地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how Arctic terns negotiate a 50,000-mile-a-year commute to summer in Kerry’s Maharee Islands. Go whale-watching off Brandon Head, then witness Ireland’s greatest wildlife spectacle: a 1,000-strong colony of grey seals on Great Blasket Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化。20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場、高爾夫球場和賽道。這是牠們堅守的土地。世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the region’s species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the city’s shrinking wetlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少。然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲大草原上生存需要機智和奸狡,特別是兩名獵人: 非洲野狗和侏獴。這兩種神秘的物種都是群居,並依靠良好協調的團隊合作來取得成功。從照顧初生之犢到尋找食物和抵禦敵人。牠們都依靠緊密的家庭來克服日常的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個複雜的關係網絡統治著地球上的所有生命 - 所有物種都相互聯繫,沒有一個能獨善其身。某些關係是單向的,但其他則是互利的。從鬆散的協力到緊密的伙伴關係,一切盡在大自然的偉大計劃之中。物種之間複雜的互動關係甚至不僅限於動物 - 一些最好的例子發生在非洲茂密的山林中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in nature’s great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尼羅鱷和河馬是非洲兩種淡水兩棲類的表表者,在整個非洲大陸的水道、河流和湖泊中都有其蹤影,亦包括南非夸祖魯納塔爾省的壯麗荒野。這兩個物種共存數千年,以不同的方式進化成依水而生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africa’s amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退潮時露出一條稱為潮間帶的海岸。這是一個令人驚愕的極端之地,受到熱帶氣旋 風浪的衝擊,又暴露在酷熱中。這裡的生物以無數怪異的方式進化。 科學家們探索這個外星之境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來到澳洲南部水域,展開一場具挑戰性的追蹤任務,並揭示鯊魚的食物來源和他們聚集於覓食熱點的原因。團隊之後一路向北,追蹤虎鯊、公牛鯊和錘頭鯊,並為他們其中一員裝上360度的背鰭攝像鏡頭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地。然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與位處北方的科學家團隊一起熬夜,他們嘗試為一隻公牛鯊裝上追蹤儀,看看這頭夜貓子入夜後有何行蹤。然後與南方團隊���起潛入80米深的海底,並嘗試為一條雌性大白鯊裝上衛星追蹤器。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨北方研究團隊窺探鯊魚的社群層級結構,他們正在研究年輕的黑鰭鯊如何學習社交和生存技能。然後與南方團隊會合,一同前往彩虹海灘,他們渴望目睹沙虎鯊最難以捉摸的行為: 交配。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger shark’s most elusive behaviour: mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索澳洲超級鯊魚大道的盡頭,了解南方的格林利島是否大白鯊遷徙路線的中途站,然後尋找北方牛鯊與生活在較冷氣候的表親,以及他們之間的基因聯繫證據。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the ends of Australia’s shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨南方團隊測試新的追蹤鯊魚技術和工具,可望減少在熱門浮潛地點的鯊魚攻擊。然後與北方團隊一起追蹤牛鯊;科學家們希望幫助當地游泳者避開即將分娩的母牛鯊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退潮時露出一條稱為潮間帶的海岸。這是一個令人驚愕的極端之地,受到熱帶氣旋 風浪的衝擊,又暴露在酷熱中。這裡的生物以無數怪異的方式進化。 科學家們探索這個外星之境。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看那些面容醜陋、只有牠們的媽媽才會喜愛的獸王。看看疣豬那粗糙的盔甲、巨型非洲牛蛙那超強的跳躍和咬合能力、野火雞那鋒利的喙和剃刀般的尖爪,還有尼羅河鱷魚那毀天滅地的強有力下顎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Confront alphas with faces only a mother could love. Inspect warthogs’ lumpy armour, giant African bullfrogs’ outsized jumping and biting skills, wild turkeys’ sharp beaks and razorlike spurs, and Nile crocodiles’ crushingly powerful jaws.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重。看看大白鯊的電力感應器、枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體、以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet nature’s most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad don’t get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white shark’s electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟。探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷,荷里活獅群大難臨頭。流浪雄獅的侵襲使女族長阿華受了重傷。由於首領喪失能力,狩獵變得困難。在尋找獅子的過程中,阿森發現了一隻鬣狗幼崽,牠的母親去打獵時遺下牠。鬣狗與孟巴肯高獅群因爭奪一隻水牛的屍體而大打出手。彌敦收到驚喜: 孟巴肯高獅群原來藏著更多的幼獅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomad’s brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的伯倫蒂保育區,兩個環尾狐猴派別因正面臨旱季日益嚴峻的挑戰而拉起戰幔。這些魅力非凡的狐猴僅在馬達加斯加島上被發現,黑白相間的尾巴十分突出,牠們活在女權體制中,每個幫派都有嚴格的等級制度,並擁有各自嚴守的領土。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的貝倫地保育區,旱季正對當地的環尾狐猴造成巨大的損耗。隨著覓食的難度增加,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹之間的關係越發緊張。隨著食物和水源日益稀缺,入侵者亦出現在附近。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Kati’s territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystal’s move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 愛爾蘭雖小,但卻充滿奇蹟。它被大西洋、莫赫懸崖及至非凡的巨人堤道圍繞,這土地一直被水力和強烈的地質力量所塑造和重塑。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giant’s Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個王國都需要一個傳位制度,生兒育女,是每個物種的生存之道。在某些社交圈,需要一整條村子來維繫家庭,但又有些只有單親父母能在野外的威脅中保護幼兒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies – and raising them – is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability of youth and the threats of the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Kati’s territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystal’s move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 愛爾蘭雖小,但卻充滿奇蹟。它被大西洋、莫赫懸崖及至非凡的巨人堤道圍繞,這土地一直被水力和強烈的地質力量所塑造和重塑。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giant’s Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個王國都需要一個傳位制度,生兒育女,是每個物種的生存之道。在某些社交圈,需要一整條村子來維繫家庭,但又有些只有單親父母能在野外的威脅中保護幼兒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies – and raising them – is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability of youth and the threats of the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重。看看大白鯊的電力感應器、枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體、以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet nature’s most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad don’t get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white shark’s electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟。探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地。然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的伯倫蒂保育區,兩個環尾狐猴派別因正面臨旱季日益嚴峻的挑戰而拉起戰幔。這些魅力非凡的狐猴僅在馬達加斯加島上被發現,黑白相間的尾巴十分突出,牠們活在女權體制中,每個幫派都有嚴格的等級制度,並擁有各自嚴守的領土。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 悄悄靠近那些寧願單打獨鬥的獨行獸王。與加拉帕戈斯陸龜一起漫步冰川;與有毒的歐洲蝰蛇共舞;觀看拉塞塔蜥蜴之間的撕咬戰;最後來領略一下豹斑海豹驚人的潛行攻擊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sidle up to lone wolf alphas who’d rather go solo. Take a glacial stroll alongside a Galápagos tortoise; dance with venomous European adders; watch a face-tearing battle between Lacerta lizards; and gasp at leopard seals’ amazing stealth attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四頭流浪雄獅組成的暴力團,正尋找可接管的獅群。他們在盧安瓜河的西岸徘徊,並已跟北方的荷里活雌獅群大打一場,現正南下進入強大的孟巴肯高獅群的地盤。孟巴肯高的雌獅群的狩獵隊阻止他們接近,但她們的策略只能持續幾天。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK pride’s territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Ava’s survival skills are still intact.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在哥倫比亞中心的熱帶雨林中長大,一隻年輕的捲尾猴必須掌握牠的攀爬技巧,學習如何尋找食物,又要學會區分敵友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的卡桑卡國家公園是一個不尋常狒狒種類的家園。狒狒有點背棄了通常與這些大型猴子相關的主導地位的攻擊性,並開展更和平的生活。與牠們生活的是一支專門的研究團隊,他們的任務是揭示這些狒狒的秘密,並瞭解是什麼讓牠們變成這樣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Colombia’s high plains of the Páramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 溫哥華島的野生太平洋海岸是卑詩省西海岸的一片古老而崎嶇的風貌。從久遠高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大濃霧蓋頂的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮濕的地方,這片原始的棲息地,既是太平洋的命脈,亦是大自然與人文精神共存之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canada’s only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古至今,很多物種都被絕種危機所威脅。就如強極一時的恐龍帝國,亦在地球上消失殆盡。但另外一些則從滅絕邊緣生存下來,慢慢恢復甚至在自然界中建立王國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires – like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounced back, and even reclaimed their kingdoms.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the joys of rain and climbing with Yasmine and Yara, and watch Winston take a dip in his new pool. Go hunting for dropped radio collars with Roger and Steve, then see what happens when the two groups of summer cubs come face-to-face.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connect with Earth’s most talkative species. Meet capuchin monkeys, who definitely don’t take a vow of silence; endure Eurasian river otters’ chilling screams; face angry fruit bats’ loud complaints; and explore orcas’ human-scale speech systems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在哥倫比亞中心的熱帶雨林中長大,一隻年輕的捲尾猴必須掌握牠的攀爬技巧,學習如何尋找食物,又要學會區分敵友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的卡桑卡國家公園是一個不尋常狒狒種類的家園。狒狒有點背棄了通常與這些大型猴子相關的主導地位的攻擊性,並開展更和平的生活。與牠們生活的是一支專門的研究團隊,他們的任務是揭示這些狒狒的秘密,並瞭解是什麼讓牠們變成這樣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Colombia’s high plains of the Páramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 流浪雄獅最近的入侵將孟巴肯高獅群分散到了遙遠的南方,留下那些失去了首領- 叛逆者的保護,易遭攻擊的幼獅。現在旱季已經過了一半,炎熱的天氣降低了河水的水位,金巴和瑪雅兄妹倆冒險過河尋找父母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the dry season lowers the waters, siblings Kimba and Maya risk crossing the river to search for their parents. They run the gauntlet of the densest populations of crocs and hippos in Africa, and face an even greater threat on the other side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物、水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長。所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功...這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africa’s greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if they’re to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區。南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護。在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19th century, the park’s establishment gave rhinos a lifeline – breeding them back from extinction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於尚比亞盧薩卡附近的李利爾大象幼兒園是四隻大象孤兒的家園。兩頭最年長的分別是四歲的墨蘇路利和贊比茲,牠們只有幾個月大的時候就開始住在那裡。這些吵鬧的嬰兒不再適合住在託兒所,是時候搬到大學校了。在兩百英里外,位於卡富埃國家公園的中心地帶,是大象的天堂 - 鳳凰營,該項目的釋放設施,年長的孤兒已經適應了野外生活。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lilayi Elephant Nursery near Lusaka in Zambia is home to four orphan elephants. The two oldest, four-year- olds Musolole and Zambezi, have been here since they were just a few months old. These boisterous babies are out-growing the nursery and it’s time to move to big school. Two hundred miles away, in the heart of Kafue National Park, lies elephant heaven - Camp Phoenix, the project’s release facility, where older orphans are already adapting to life in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場中的禽畜多是眾多歌曲和故事的主角,牠們在全球各地歡慶,但卻很少談起牠們在野外的兄弟姊妹物種。這些主要被稱為牲畜、負軛的野獸,甚至寵物,必須在其家養親屬的圍欄外自生自滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild. These animals known primarily as livestock, beasts of burden, or even pets must fend for themselves beyond the fences of their domesticated kin.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Colombia’s high plains of the Páramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨北方研究團隊窺探鯊魚的社群層級結構,他們正在研究年輕的黑鰭鯊如何學習社交和生存技能。然後與南方團隊會合,一同前往彩虹海灘,他們渴望目睹沙虎鯊最難以捉摸的行為: 交配。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger shark’s most elusive behaviour: mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Have you ever wondered why mandrills have such colorful faces, why vultures are bald, or even why hammerheads have, well, hammer-shaped heads? Discover how animals managed to survive by evolving from the neck up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在盧安瓜谷的荷里活獅群正身處水深火熱。向北避難以逃離流浪雄獅,其他獅子來到威脅霸佔牠們的領土。當牠們嘗試回歸時,流浪雄獅又趕到阻止牠們前進。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the last few weeks of the dry season, the prides stick close to the only available water in the river. But in Luangwa, that proximity spells danger - especially when the scent of a hippo kill compels the Hollywoods to cross the river.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎小猩猩托潘,她是一個需要代孕媽媽照顧的孤兒。當她還在幼兒園學習之時,她的同學們已經進入了初中、高中和野外實習學校。與此同時,16歲的卡斯帕正在為畢業做著準備。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觀察幼兒園裡蓬勃發展的友誼和物種間的聯繫,窺探初中生瓦伦蒂诺、尤特里斯和马达拉之間的兄弟情誼。我們看到心不在焉的貝尼沉浸在對食物的熱愛中,還遭到了高年級學生的毆打。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的卡桑卡國家公園是一個不尋常狒狒種類的家園。狒狒有點背棄了通常與這些大型猴子相關的主導地位的攻擊性,並開展更和平的生活。與牠們生活的是一支專門的研究團隊,他們的任務是揭示這些狒狒的秘密,並瞭解是什麼讓牠們變成這樣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kasanka National Park in Zambia is home to an unusual species of baboon. Kinda baboons have turned their backs on the aggressive displays of dominance usually associated with these large monkeys and lead altogether more peaceful lives. Living alongside one troop is a dedicated team of researchers whose mission it is to uncover these baboons’ secrets and understand what makes them who they are.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 不速之客以量取勝,獲取領地,有些動物群被列為「害蟲」,但牠們若要生存,就是要找到不歡迎牠們的安身之所。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered “pests.” But their very survival may depend on finding a home where they’re not welcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物、水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長。所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功...這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africa’s greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if they’re to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區。南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護。在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19th century, the park’s establishment gave rhinos a lifeline – breeding them back from extinction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索澳洲超級鯊魚大道的盡頭,了解南方的格林利島是否大白鯊遷徙路線的中途站,然後尋找北方牛鯊與生活在較冷氣候的表親,以及他們之間的基因聯繫證據。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the ends of Australia’s shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎小猩猩托潘,她是一個需要代孕媽媽照顧的孤兒。當她還在幼兒園學習之時,她的同學們已經進入了初中、高中和野外實習學校。與此同時,16歲的卡斯帕正在為畢業做著準備。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觀察幼兒園裡蓬勃發展的友誼和物種間的聯繫,窺探初中生瓦伦蒂诺、尤特里斯和马达拉之間的兄弟情誼。我們看到心不在焉的貝尼沉浸在對食物的熱愛中,還遭到了高年級學生的毆打。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the last few weeks of the dry season, the prides stick close to the only available water in the river. But in Luangwa, that proximity spells danger - especially when the scent of a hippo kill compels the Hollywoods to cross the river.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地理和生物學尺度上,人類只是霎眼間的存在罷了,但我們卻影響了許多動物的進化路徑。探索人類對狗、狼、郊狼和大象等的影響。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In geological and biological scales, humans have only been around for the blink of an eye, and yet we’ve managed to influence the evolutionary path for many animals. Explore the human impact on dogs, wolves, coyotes, elephants, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎小猩猩托潘,她是一個需要代孕媽媽照顧的孤兒。當她還在幼兒園學習之時,她的同學們已經進入了初中、高中和野外實習學校。與此同時,16歲的卡斯帕正在為畢業做著準備。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旱季即將結束,孟巴肯高獅群面臨前所未有的艱難時刻。牠們的女族長和最強獵人蘇拉比被一頭水牛所傷,讓她命懸一線。同時,彌敦找到了獅群中最年輕的成員之一,孤身走失的小獅斑點。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重。看看大白鯊的電力感應器、枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體、以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet nature’s most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad don’t get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white shark’s electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟。探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為你介紹一隻非常特別的猴子 - 麥當娜。她是有史以來第一隻從出生到成年直至現在都在學習的金達狒狒,關鍵的是,她正在尋找伴侶。金達狒狒最近才被確定為一個物種,牠們鮮為人知亦不為人理解。但麥當娜正在幫助改變這情況。她可能抓住解開金達狒狒獨特兩性關係秘密的關鍵。這些狒狒獨一無二。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet Madonna, a very special monkey. She’s the first Kinda baboon ever to be studied from birth to adulthood and now, critically, she’s looking for a mate. Only recently identified as a species in their own right, Kinda baboons are little known and little understood. But Madonna is helping change all that. She may just hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Kinda’s unique female-male relationships. These are baboons like no others.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人多好辦事,放諸野外同樣適用。這就是眾多物種都選擇群居的原因。保護族群才能賴以生存。對於這些動物,保護代表隔離 - 從外界的威脅中找到庇護所。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There’s strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it’s the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨南方團隊測試新的追蹤鯊魚技術和工具,可望減少在熱門浮潛地點的鯊魚攻擊。然後與北方團隊一起追蹤牛鯊;科學家們希望幫助當地游泳者避開即將分娩的母牛鯊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎小猩猩托潘,她是一個需要代孕媽媽照顧的孤兒。當她還在幼兒園學習之時,她的同學們已經進入了初中、高中和野外實習學校。與此同時,16歲的卡斯帕正在為畢業做著準備。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​揭開沼澤地那詭異卻迷人的面紗: 這些濕地數百年來激發了無數傳說與民間故事,同時成為連結生與死的重要橋樑。與飢餓的鱷魚一同潛泳,目睹梅花鹿為了覓食而賭上性命的瞬間,並觀察食肉植物迅速捕捉獵物的驚人畫面。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旱季即將結束,孟巴肯高獅群面臨前所未有的艱難時刻。牠們的女族長和最強獵人蘇拉比被一頭水牛所傷,讓她命懸一線。同時,彌敦找到了獅群中最年輕的成員之一,孤身走失的小獅斑點。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重。看看大白鯊的電力感應器、枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體、以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet nature’s most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad don’t get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white shark’s electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟。探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為你介紹一隻非常特別的猴子 - 麥當娜。她是有史以來第一隻從出生到成年直至現在都在學習的金達狒狒,關鍵的是,她正在尋找伴侶。金達狒狒最近才被確定為一個物種,牠們鮮為人知亦不為人理解。但麥當娜正在幫助改變這情況。她可能抓住解開金達狒狒獨特兩性關係秘密的關鍵。這些狒狒獨一無二。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet Madonna, a very special monkey. She’s the first Kinda baboon ever to be studied from birth to adulthood and now, critically, she’s looking for a mate. Only recently identified as a species in their own right, Kinda baboons are little known and little understood. But Madonna is helping change all that. She may just hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Kinda’s unique female-male relationships. These are baboons like no others.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觀察幼兒園裡蓬勃發展的友誼和物種間的聯繫,窺探初中生瓦伦蒂诺、尤特里斯和马达拉之間的兄弟情誼。我們看到心不在焉的貝尼沉浸在對食物的熱愛中,還遭到了高年級學生的毆打。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨南方團隊測試新的追蹤鯊魚技術和工具,可望減少在熱門浮潛地點的鯊魚攻擊。然後與北方團隊一起追蹤牛鯊;科學家們希望幫助當地游泳者避開即將分娩的母牛鯊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重。看看大白鯊的電力感應器、枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體、以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物界中一些最有趣的適應性是無形的。研究這些隱藏的內部變化,以觀察不同的動物如何用驚人且看不見的方式進化並生存。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some of the most interesting adaptations in the animal world are completely invisible. Study these hidden, internal alterations to see how different animals have evolved to survive in amazing and unseen ways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯尼亞邁出了重要的一步,在桑布魯區中心地段開設第一個社區經營的犀牛保育區。非法武裝偷獵團對肯尼亞犀牛的威脅達到40年來最高,這讓保育區更顯重要。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kenya takes a major step with the opening of its first community-run rhino sanctuary in the heart of Samburu territory. The threat to Kenya’s rhinos from armed, illegal poaching gangs is the highest its been in 40 years, which makes the sanctuary vital.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 數百萬年前,被遺棄的生物發現自己被困在馬達加斯加崎嶇的海岸上,與大陸隔絕,新來者唯有進化。這是一個神奇的世界,稀有而獨特的動物完美地適應了牠們的熱帶世外桃源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Millions of years ago, castaway creatures were stranded on the rugged shores of Madagascar. Left to evolve on their own, they’ve found a way to perfectly adapt to their tropical climate. Now, see what life is like for a family of ring-tailed lemurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這島是狐猴的天地。狐猴是馬達加斯加迷人的樹棲原始靈長類動物,從最大的大狐猴到倭狐猴,各種大小、顏色和形狀都有。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The island is the land of Lemurs. Lemurs are fascinating arboreal primitive primates of Madagascar represented in all sizes, colors, and shapes from the largest Indri to the tiny mouse lemur.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於南非的霍格斯巴克,有兩種迷人的靈長類動物棲居其中: 長尾猴和開普鸚鵡。窺探牠們如何克服棲息地日益萎縮的困境,並充分利用機會,穿越城鎮尋找食物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hogsback, South Africa, is home to two fascinating primates: The Samango monkeys and the Cape Parrots. See how they overcome habit loss, travel across town for food, and make the most of a difficult situation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貝拉貝拉狒狒隊伍是一個成功的查克馬狒狒族群,牠們在南非沃特伯格山脈的一個原始山谷中開枝散葉。但繁華背後卻有一個問題——牠們不是山谷中唯一的狒狒族群。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Bambelela Troop is a successful and gregarious troop of Chacma Baboons that live in a pristine valley in the Waterberg Mountains of South Africa. But they have a problem—they’re not the only baboons around.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獅尾狒是一種稀有的猴子,只棲居於埃塞俄比亞塞米恩山脈之中,他們富有魅力,愛發出聲音,並經常處於熱情和對抗之間。觀察牠們如何面對棲息地萎縮的挑戰——以及彼此之間的鬥爭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. They’re charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitat—and each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 進入南非的荒野,近距離觀察這個大陸最容易被誤解的靈長類動物之一。跟人類一樣,這些靈長類動物具有獨特的個性,與家人和朋友都有著強烈的聯繫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continent’s most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 愛爾蘭雖小,但卻充滿奇蹟。它被大西洋、莫赫懸崖及至非凡的巨人堤道圍繞,這土地一直被水力和強烈的地質力量所塑造和重塑。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giant’s Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 溫哥華島的野生太平洋海岸是卑詩省西海岸的一片古老而崎嶇的風貌。從久遠高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大濃霧蓋頂的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮濕的地方,這片原始的棲息地,既是太平洋的命脈,亦是大自然與人文精神共存之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canada’s only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於尚比亞盧薩卡附近的李利爾大象幼兒園是四隻大象孤兒的家園。兩頭最年長的分別是四歲的墨蘇路利和贊比茲,牠們只有幾個月大的時候就開始住在那裡。這些吵鬧的嬰兒不再適合住在託兒所,是時候搬到大學校了。在兩百英里外,位於卡富埃國家公園的中心地帶,是大象的天堂 - 鳳凰營,該項目的釋放設施,年長的孤兒已經適應了野外生活。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lilayi Elephant Nursery near Lusaka in Zambia is home to four orphan elephants. The two oldest, four-year- olds Musolole and Zambezi, have been here since they were just a few months old. These boisterous babies are out-growing the nursery and it’s time to move to big school. Two hundred miles away, in the heart of Kafue National Park, lies elephant heaven - Camp Phoenix, the project’s release facility, where older orphans are already adapting to life in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的卡桑卡國家公園是一個不尋常狒狒種類的家園。狒狒有點背棄了通常與這些大型猴子相關的主導地位的攻擊性,並開展更和平的生活。與牠們生活的是一支專門的研究團隊,他們的任務是揭示這些狒狒的秘密,並瞭解是什麼讓牠們變成這樣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kasanka National Park in Zambia is home to an unusual species of baboon. Kinda baboons have turned their backs on the aggressive displays of dominance usually associated with these large monkeys and lead altogether more peaceful lives. Living alongside one troop is a dedicated team of researchers whose mission it is to uncover these baboons’ secrets and understand what makes them who they are.

Only recently identified as a species in their own right, Kinda baboons are little known and little understood. But Madonna is helping change all that. She may just hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Kinda’s unique female-male relationships. These are baboons like no others.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力: 群體的生存。但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?《秘「蜜」日記》講述這個故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee’s Diary tells that story.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中。牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《大象傳奇》有三個故事。一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲。一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶。一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠。這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.programme_title_tc: 巨象同盟: 長牙兄弟情
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象: 克雷格、帕斯卡與以掃。深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言、複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the world’s largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」。本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the ‘arribada’, or ‘arrival’. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚、虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅。讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State’s landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas’ unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿、怪誕的生存策略。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力: 群體的生存。但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?《秘「蜜」日記》講述這個故事。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the world’s largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」。本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the ‘arribada’, or ‘arrival’. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚、虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅。讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State’s landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas’ unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿、怪誕的生存策略。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斑馬為何有斑紋?企鵝如何在水底看東西?為何樹蛙的眼睛是紅色的?在可見的探索中,發掘一些動物如何進化以達到極佳的視力,而另一些卻進化至幾乎隱形。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Why do zebras have stripes? How do penguins see underwater? And why are a tree frog’s eyes red? In this exploration of sight, discover how some animals have evolved to see extremely well while others have evolved to be nearly invisible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 肯尼亞的捕獲隊伍前往索馬里邊境捕獲50隻被稱為亨氏牛羚的珍稀瀕危羚羊。在過去十年中,亨氏牛羚的數量一直急劇下降,保育組織知道通過捕獲並將它們置於受保護的零捕獵者保育區,有助數量回升。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Capture teams from Kenya head to Somali border to capture 50 rare and endangered antelope called a hirola. The hirola numbers have been plummeting over the last decade, and conservation groups know that by capturing and placing them into a protected predator-free conservancy they will rebound.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中。牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群勇敢的雄性企鵝聚集在水邊,準備在岸上進行危險的旅程。面對前路的險途,數量多比較安全。這些小企鵝有著重要的任務,繁殖的時候到了,牠們必須在雌性到來前找到一個洞穴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the water’s edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. It’s time to breed and they must find a burrow before the females arrive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭的西岸不像世上任何地方。從冰川覆蓋的山脈到原始雨林,再到嚴酷的寒冷海域,壯麗景致令人難以置信。這片與世隔絕幾乎未被觸及的桃花園,隱藏著許多土生的動物。進化的漂流者,每一個都是罕見的生態瑰寶。從啄羊鸚鵡和害羞的企鵝到哺乳類般的鷸鴕和古老的鰻魚,為了於這種條件下生存,這裡的野生動物必須堅強,狡猾和足智多謀。沿著西岸的旅程讓你窺見這片美地,以及生活在這裡的野生動物的考驗和磨難。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New Zealand’s West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭有兩個野生堡壘保護脆弱的土生動物: 一個是受到鹽水護城河保護的偏遠島嶼,另一個是被防捕食者屏障包圍的山頂城堡。這是這些精緻的庇護所和在其中茁壯成長的動物的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries and the life that thrives within them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭東岸的春天是紐西蘭海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好時光。牠們已回到自己的土地準備繁殖。但因惡劣的地形、無常的天氣和飢餓的掠食者使牠們的生活變得困難。只有最強者才能生存下去,並薪火相傳下去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring on New Zealand’s east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. They’ve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives difficult for them. Only the strongest will survive to carry forward their legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紐西蘭與世隔絕的島嶼是不凡的天堂及家園,以擁有多元又獨特的野生動物聞名。尤以不會飛的鳥類、古代爬行類和沿海哺乳類最為人所共知,仔細觀察將會發現另一個世界。這裡有微型的怪物、小型的掠奪者和微小的恐怖,卻帶來了非凡的生命。每個獵人也是獵物﹐永遠需要努力生存。走進灌木叢,又會發現不同規模的生活。從巨型肉食蜈蚣和夜行蟋蟀到捕魚蛛和使用絲質陷阱的發光蠕蟲。奇怪而奇妙,這些無名英雄是野性紐西蘭最令人毛骨悚然的爬行類。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: New Zealand’s isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand’s Creepiest Crawlies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個王國都需要一個傳位制度,生兒育女,是每個物種的生存之道。在某些社交圈,需要一整條村子來維繫家庭,但又有些只有單親父母能在野外的威脅中保護幼兒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies – and raising them – is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability of youth and the threats of the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古至今,很多物種都被絕種危機所威脅。就如強極一時的恐龍帝國,亦在地球上消失殆盡。但另外一些則從滅絕邊緣生存下來,慢慢恢復甚至在自然界中建立王國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires – like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounced back, and even reclaimed their kingdoms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場中的禽畜多是眾多歌曲和故事的主角,牠們在全球各地歡慶,但卻很少談起牠們在野外的兄弟姊妹物種。這些主要被稱為牲畜、負軛的野獸,甚至寵物,必須在其家養親屬的圍欄外自生自滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild. These animals known primarily as livestock, beasts of burden, or even pets must fend for themselves beyond the fences of their domesticated kin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 不速之客以量取勝,獲取領地,有些動物群被列為「害蟲」,但牠們若要生存,就是要找到不歡迎牠們的安身之所。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered “pests.” But their very survival may depend on finding a home where they’re not welcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人多好辦事,放諸野外同樣適用。這就是眾多物種都選擇群居的原因。保護族群才能賴以生存。對於這些動物,保護代表隔離 - 從外界的威脅中找到庇護所。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There’s strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it’s the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物之間的睡眠策略千變萬化,然而睡眠似乎是一種再普遍不過的行為。但究竟為何動物需要睡眠呢?它們如何應對無法休息或在野外昏迷可能帶來的危險?這些問題只是《野生動物如何睡覺》中的冰山一角。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕。冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配。一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒。大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子。三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季。跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantic’s intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存。被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己。馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里。每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondie’s love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on July’s salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜。看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母。為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油。挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備。至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睾酮的氣息。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Beach.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間。新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導「山姆之子」的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到托斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the engineering wonders of ancient Rome to the bloody medieval battles of Tuscany, and the colossal marble quarries of Carrara, journey across Central Italy and discover it like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山、偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家。它們就是迷人的義大利島國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italys Islands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟、似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With some of the most beautiful Greek temples on the Mediterranean, cities that just seem to float above the sea, and one of the most powerful volcanoes on Earth, this region of Italy feels like another world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞、現代的高爾夫球場、神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africas South Coast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈、繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物。這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪: 小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然。三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來臨。北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物、配偶,並組織家庭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring comes to the Dales and North York Moors National Parks, the season when the parks animals must find food, a mate and raise a family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備。至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睾酮的氣息。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Beach.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間。新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然。三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This stunning series uncovers The Secret Life Of Owls as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智能。這是能震撼你的一集。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作。但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機。Playstation從此屹立不倒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.
