epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間。新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事:  在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the jungles of a remote archipelago in the South Pacific, a biologist is attempting to do something Charles Darwin and Ernst Mayr never accomplished: catch evolution in the act of creating new species. Albert Uy is on the verge of an amazing discovery in the Solomon Islands, but theres a threat looming on the horizon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐、一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力、溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「雞」翼和燒「牛扒」。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.programme_title_tc: 紅粉佳人: 無所畏懼
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: P!nk 是流行與搖滾樂壇的強大存在。雖然她最初被視為九○年代末眾多青少年流行歌手之一,但她最終開創了屬於自己的音樂風格,並穩固了無可取代的地位。她,是當今樂壇不可忽視的力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pink is a powerhouse of pop and rock music. Although initially seen as yet another act in the late 90’s crowd of teen pop acts, she has since gone on to define her own genre and solidified her place as a standout from the rest. She is a force to be reckoned with in the music scene.

epg.programme_title_tc: 妮可基嫚:  走向奧斯卡
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部專題紀錄片聚焦澳洲傳奇 Nicole Kidman 的早年生活、電影事業,以及她所經歷的高低起伏。從叢林中的聖誕節到奧斯卡得主,她的故事充滿啟發與考驗。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feature documentary about the early life, filmic career, and trials and tribulations of Australian icon, Nicole Kidman. From a Bush Christmas to Oscar winning performances, her story is one of inspiration and hardship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進 Cher 的世界——這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Cher, an enduring icon whose journey from humble beginnings to superstardom has shaped pop culture for over five decades

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力。從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會。在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺。但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷、最貧瘠的環境中繁衍。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報。動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙。牠們必須學習覓食、保護家園、吸引配偶、養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind - staying alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅。從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們。人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.programme_title_tc: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈、繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物。這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠、巨大的鑽石和​​世上最大的內陸綠洲之上。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力。從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會。在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺。但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷、最貧瘠的環境中繁衍。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報。動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙。牠們必須學習覓食、保護家園、吸引配偶、養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind - staying alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺。但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷、最貧瘠的環境中繁衍。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called “bubble feeding” to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的濃厚起司傳統,當地家族乳酪坊的技藝世代相傳,延續至今。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes in the cheesy traditions of la belle province, Quebec, where family fromageries’ traditions have been passed on through generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes a mini cheese trip around the world in his own backyard, Toronto, one of the most diverse and cultural cities on the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由「支持在地」的精神所驅動。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its ‘support local’ mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進 Cher 的世界——這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Cher, an enduring icon whose journey from humble beginnings to superstardom has shaped pop culture for over five decades

epg.programme_title_tc: 布魯斯威利: 全美英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 布斯韋利士憑著在《虎膽龍威》中飾演尊麥堅這個標誌性角色而成為巨星,他在傳奇的演藝生涯演出過百部電影。他以魅力和幽默而聞名,但卻在2022年遭遇悲慘的挫折。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Willis became a star with his iconic role as John McClane in Die Hard, leading to a legendary career with over 100 films. Known for his charm and humor, his career faced a tragic setback in 2022.

epg.programme_title_tc: 內馬爾: 巴西頭號射手
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊。內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazils number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪: 小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called “bubble feeding” to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理查德・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將「旋轉圍捕」技巧適應於當地環境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人。在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習游泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fatal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物——沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友: 海豚的協助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸。雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽。然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them to learn new defense behaviors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗。牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.programme_title_tc: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計。軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze attacks at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被征服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rob journeys along the length of the Panama Canal to learn how the un-conquerable Isthmus was bent to the will and skill of determined engineers, creating one of the seven wonders of the Modern World.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠、巨大的鑽石和​​世上最大的內陸綠洲之上。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千尺高空探索西開普省驚人的海岸線、雄偉的山脈和豐富多樣的大都會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類、植物、動物、細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點: 死亡。我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的起司尋味之旅來到希臘——菲達起司的發源地,起司文化可追溯至數千年前的古老傳統。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s cheese quest continues in Greece, the motherland of Feta, and where cheese culture dates back thousands of years in ancient practices.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由「支持在地」的精神所驅動。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its ‘support local’ mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉。徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.programme_title_tc: 內馬爾: 巴西頭號射手
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊。內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazils number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

epg.programme_title_tc: 布萊德彼特: 突破好萊塢
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 他可能是最性感的荷里活演員之一,但他的職業和個人目標比他的外表更有味道。布萊德彼特。整個荷里活首屈一指的人物之一。一個默默無聞的天才轉變為超級巨星的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: He may be one of the sexiest Hollywood actors, but his career and personal goals offer much more than his looks. Brad Pitt. One of the leading names in all of Hollywood. The well-known story of an unknown talent who transformed into a superstar.

epg.programme_title_tc: 湯姆漢克斯: 演無不克
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色。他贏得了「美國好人」、「平民」和藝術游牧民的美譽。而我們都知道他……是 湯姆漢克斯。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings to an aspiring thespian to acting as some of the world’s most iconic and notable characters. He has picked up a reputation as ‘America’s Nice Guy’, ’The Everyman’ and a nomad of the arts. But we all know him… as Tom Hanks.

epg.programme_title_tc: 凱莉安德伍: 南方福音
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從奧克拉荷馬州契科塔的小鎮農場出發,走上世界最大舞台——凱莉.安德伍的旅程,是一個關於夢想、歌聲,以及無法被忽視的熱情的故事。這就是凱莉.安德伍的傳奇——從美國甜心蛻變為當代樂壇的活傳奇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town farm in Checotah, Oklahoma, to the biggest stages in the world — Carrie Underwood’s journey is the story of a dream, a voice, and a fire that couldn’t be ignored. This is the story of Carrie Underwood — the all-American girl who became a living legend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《史汀: 自強不息》是一部引人入勝的紀錄片,深入探索這位音樂史上最具代表性人物之一的多面人生。影片以前所未有的視角,帶領觀眾走進一位音樂傳奇的內心世界,展現他的藝術如何持續啟發並挑戰世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sting: Ever Evolving is an enthralling documentary that delves into the multifaceted life of one of musics most iconic figures. The documentary offers an unprecedented glimpse into the mind of a musical legend, showcasing how his art continues to inspire and challenge the world.

epg.programme_title_tc: 凱特溫斯蕾: 天生女主角
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因《鐵達尼號》而聞名的奧斯卡得主琦溫斯莉因在荷里活猛片和獨立電影中多變而激烈的演技而受讚譽,使她穩佔同代最優秀演員一席位。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Oscar-winner Kate Winslet, known for Titanic, is celebrated for her versatile, intense performances in both Hollywood blockbusters and indie films, cementing her as one of the finest actors of her generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑拉德在長達20多年的輝煌職業生涯中體驗並成功晉身球壇巔峰,作為球員和教練捧起過獎盃,又代表過國家隊。但有高山就會伴隨低谷。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an illustrious professional career that spans over 20 years, Gerrard has experienced and succeeded at the pinnacle of the sport, lifting trophies as a player and manager, and representing his country. But with the highs, came the lows.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程。這是絕無僅有的…基斯坦勞朗拿度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性、感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾岩士唐最完整的人生故事—從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月—以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.programme_title_tc: 湯姆漢克斯: 演無不克
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色。他贏得了「美國好人」、「平民」和藝術游牧民的美譽。而我們都知道他……是 湯姆漢克斯。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings to an aspiring thespian to acting as some of the world’s most iconic and notable characters. He has picked up a reputation as ‘America’s Nice Guy’, ’The Everyman’ and a nomad of the arts. But we all know him… as Tom Hanks.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哈里遜福特: 好萊塢英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏里遜福。他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏托邦未來的銀翼殺手。但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone thinks they know Harrison Ford. They know the adventurous Nazi-fighting archaeologist and the Blade Runner from a dystopian future. But nobody really knows the man behind the movies once the cameras have stopped rolling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千尺高空探索西開普省驚人的海岸線、雄偉的山脈和豐富多樣的大都會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌。從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibias secrets will be revealed.

epg.programme_title_tc: 凱莉安德伍: 南方福音
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從奧克拉荷馬州契科塔的小鎮農場出發,走上世界最大舞台——凱莉.安德伍的旅程,是一個關於夢想、歌聲,以及無法被忽視的熱情的故事。這就是凱莉.安德伍的傳奇——從美國甜心蛻變為當代樂壇的活傳奇。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報。動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙。牠們必須學習覓食、保護家園、吸引配偶、養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind - staying alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉。徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化、國際化、全球化的城市。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東—孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一—雲南。 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅。從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們。人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.programme_title_tc: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐、一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力、溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「雞」翼和燒「牛扒」。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子、炸「雞」三文治和越南「鮎魚」;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的「後院」,發現美味的素壽司、開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食: 素海鮮、檸檬汁「海鮮」冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅。之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哈里遜福特: 好萊塢英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏里遜福。他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏托邦未來的銀翼殺手。但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone thinks they know Harrison Ford. They know the adventurous Nazi-fighting archaeologist and the Blade Runner from a dystopian future. But nobody really knows the man behind the movies once the cameras have stopped rolling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穆罕默德阿里是有史以來最偉大的拳擊手,至今仍是全球標誌。他的名字依舊令人尊敬。聽聽那些認識他的人,重溫他的傳奇戰鬥,並探索拳擊界最偉大象徵的一生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Muhammad Ali, the greatest fighter ever, remains a global icon. His name still commands respect. Hear from those who knew him, relive his legendary fights, and explore the life of boxing’s greatest symbol.

epg.programme_title_tc: 茱莉亞羅勃茲: 美麗標誌
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索好萊塢最受喜愛的女星 Julia Roberts 的非凡人生。從《麻雀變鳳凰》的突破性演出,到奧斯卡獲獎角色,本片呈現她的成長歷程、持久魅力與對影壇的深遠影響,刻畫一位令人難忘的巨星。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the extraordinary life of Julia Roberts, Hollywood’s beloved icon. From her breakout role in Pretty Woman to her Oscar-winning performances, this documentary explores her journey, enduring charm, and impact on cinema, capturing the heart of an unforgettable star.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌。從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibias secrets will be revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在豐富多彩的非洲國家-尚比亞上空翱翔。包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和擠滿世上最貧窮的人的市場。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐、一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力、溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「雞」翼和燒「牛扒」。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子、炸「雞」三文治和越南「鮎魚」;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的「後院」,發現美味的素壽司、開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食: 素海鮮、檸檬汁「海鮮」冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅。之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子、炸「雞」三文治和越南「鮎魚」;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called “bubble feeding” to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理查德・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將「旋轉圍捕」技巧適應於當地環境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人。在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習游泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fatal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物——沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友: 海豚的協助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸。雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽。然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them to learn new defense behaviors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗。牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東—孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一—雲南。 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島—一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.programme_title_tc: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計。軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze attacks at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被征服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rob journeys along the length of the Panama Canal to learn how the un-conquerable Isthmus was bent to the will and skill of determined engineers, creating one of the seven wonders of the Modern World.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智能。這是能震撼你的一集。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作。但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機。Playstation從此屹立不倒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造「花札」卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平台。這就是任天堂的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計、生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.programme_title_tc: 茱莉亞羅勃茲: 美麗標誌
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索好萊塢最受喜愛的女星 Julia Roberts 的非凡人生。從《麻雀變鳳凰》的突破性演出,到奧斯卡獲獎角色,本片呈現她的成長歷程、持久魅力與對影壇的深遠影響,刻畫一位令人難忘的巨星。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the extraordinary life of Julia Roberts, Hollywood’s beloved icon. From her breakout role in Pretty Woman to her Oscar-winning performances, this documentary explores her journey, enduring charm, and impact on cinema, capturing the heart of an unforgettable star.

epg.programme_title_tc: 海倫米蘭: 舞台與銀幕的女王
epg.programme_title_en: Helen Mirren: Queen Of Stage And Screen
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片深入探討 Helen Mirren 無畏的演藝生涯,追溯她從平凡出身到成為全球巨星的旅程,涵蓋她在劇場的早期成就,以及橫跨電影與電視的多元角色表現。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary explores Helen Mirren’s fearless career, tracing her journey from a humble upbringing to becoming a global icon. It covers her early successes in the world of theatre as well as her wide range of film and television roles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 凱莉米洛: 流行天后
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片記錄了 Kylie Minogue 非凡的一生與事業,從她在澳洲肥皂劇《鄰居》中的早期演出,到躍升為全球音樂天后的精彩歷程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary chronicles the extraordinary life and career of Kylie Minogue, from her early days on the Australian soap opera Neighbours to her rise as a global music sensation.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: F-14雄猫战斗机于1986年的电影《壮志凌云》中亮相大银幕,并参加了锡德拉湾事件、冷战对抗和两伊战争等重大军事冲突。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The F-14 Tomcat fighter jet hit the big screen in 1986s Top Gun and flew in major military conflicts like the Gulf of Sidra incident, Cold War confrontations and the Iran-Iraq War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事:  在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the jungles of a remote archipelago in the South Pacific, a biologist is attempting to do something Charles Darwin and Ernst Mayr never accomplished: catch evolution in the act of creating new species. Albert Uy is on the verge of an amazing discovery in the Solomon Islands, but theres a threat looming on the horizon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes a mini cheese trip around the world in his own backyard, Toronto, one of the most diverse and cultural cities on the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由「支持在地」的精神所驅動。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its ‘support local’ mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由「支持在地」的精神所驅動。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its ‘support local’ mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉。徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子、炸「雞」三文治和越南「鮎魚」;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的「後院」,發現美味的素壽司、開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食: 素海鮮、檸檬汁「海鮮」冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅。之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化、國際化、全球化的城市。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東—孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his journey discovering Chinas history through its food, Adam arrives in Shandong - birthplace of Confucius and one of the oldest and most influential culinary traditions in China.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一—雲南。 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives in one of the most fascinating Chinese provinces - Yunnan. Infused with spice and fragrance from Southeast and Central Asia, people from all around China have fallen in love with this cuisine and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明抵達炎熱的四川省和湖南省,而這次著名廚師兼作家,同時也是當地的專家導遊鄧扶霞也一併同行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time hes joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島—一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺。但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷、最貧瘠的環境中繁衍。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報。動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙。牠們必須學習覓食、保護家園、吸引配偶、養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind - staying alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類、植物、動物、細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點: 死亡。我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事:  在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the jungles of a remote archipelago in the South Pacific, a biologist is attempting to do something Charles Darwin and Ernst Mayr never accomplished: catch evolution in the act of creating new species. Albert Uy is on the verge of an amazing discovery in the Solomon Islands, but theres a threat looming on the horizon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.programme_title_tc: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計。軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze attacks at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈、繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物。這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠、巨大的鑽石和​​世上最大的內陸綠洲之上。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千尺高空探索西開普省驚人的海岸線、雄偉的山脈和豐富多樣的大都會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌。從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibias secrets will be revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在豐富多彩的非洲國家-尚比亞上空翱翔。包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和擠滿世上最貧窮的人的市場。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: F-14雄猫战斗机于1986年的电影《壮志凌云》中亮相大银幕,并参加了锡德拉湾事件、冷战对抗和两伊战争等重大军事冲突。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The F-14 Tomcat fighter jet hit the big screen in 1986s Top Gun and flew in major military conflicts like the Gulf of Sidra incident, Cold War confrontations and the Iran-Iraq War.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called “bubble feeding” to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理查德・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將「旋轉圍捕」技巧適應於當地環境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人。在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習游泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fatal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物——沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友: 海豚的協助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸。雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽。然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them to learn new defense behaviors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗。牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事:  在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the jungles of a remote archipelago in the South Pacific, a biologist is attempting to do something Charles Darwin and Ernst Mayr never accomplished: catch evolution in the act of creating new species. Albert Uy is on the verge of an amazing discovery in the Solomon Islands, but theres a threat looming on the horizon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類、植物、動物、細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點: 死亡。我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事:  在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the jungles of a remote archipelago in the South Pacific, a biologist is attempting to do something Charles Darwin and Ernst Mayr never accomplished: catch evolution in the act of creating new species. Albert Uy is on the verge of an amazing discovery in the Solomon Islands, but theres a threat looming on the horizon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samoyed dogs, known as "smiling angels" are in fact not easy to raise. They require enough love and dedication, especially extraordinary physical strength!!! For you to be happy and healthy with them.
If you want to raise a Samoyed, or already own one, we hope you can give them the best care and love, and make them your best partners. Come and jot notes of the hard work and tears shared by expert owners :)!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! How can one be the creator of the underwater world? Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Whilst the majority of us Brits look forward to the summer months, for the nations' dog rescuers, rising temperatures create a potentially lethal danger for the country's canines. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Comedian Alan Davies is acting vet's assistant at Harmsworth animal hospital in London. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Because of its isolated habitat, little is known about the Galapagos Shark and its behaviors. And that's enough to get Shark Gordon interested, catching and tagging a group of the sharks to help…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Because of its isolated habitat, little is known about the Galapagos Shark and its behaviors. And that's enough to get Shark Gordon interested, catching and tagging a group of the sharks to help…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: From rams to lizards, many animals rely on direct body-to-body combat. This episode uncovers headbutts, wrestling, and full-on melees in the natural world.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From rams to lizards, many animals rely on direct body-to-body combat. This episode uncovers headbutts, wrestling, and full-on melees in the natural world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Safari Flix is hosted by an experienced ranger/guide who provides compelling in-the-moment narration on the action as it happens. Not only will viewers marvel at the incredible wildlife sightings featured in the show, but so too will they be exposed to a wealth of information on the animals in particular and the African bush and pressing environmental matters in general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this episode we'll explore the animal sense of sight, and you’ll see there’s a lot more to this than meets the naked eye. Only you won’t believe how some animals see the world....

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re not whales at all, but by far the largest fish in the sea. Yet at nearly 50 feet in length and weighing 20 tons or more, they eat only the smallest marine animals. They are not a threat to humans, but their numbers are dramatically shrinking. Like elephants slaughtered for their ivory tusks, whale sharks are relentlessly pursued by poachers. From Africa to Asia, they are targeted for their meat and immense fins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: While all life began in the oceans, human beings now rely on technology to navigate the seven seas – left to our own devices; we’re like the proverbial fish out of water. Only the other way around. Once underwater our vision becomes blurred, with light diminished, our hearing becomes muffled and distorted, and our sense of smell is rendered useless.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this episode of Animal Super Senses, we find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground... and find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world, …a busy, complex web of life lies just beneath our feet. Fossorial animals are well adapted to life underground. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冒險家弗林.卡森收到一幅指向所羅門王礦脈的神秘地圖.當地圖被盜後,弗林踏上旅程尋回地圖及所羅門之鑰,一旦缺少這本書,地圖也將變得毫無用處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adventurer Flynn Carsen receives a secret map to King Solomons Mines. When the map is stolen, Flynn sets out to find the map and the Key of Solomons book, without which the map is useless anyway.

epg.programme_title_en: The Librarian: The Curse Of The Judas Chalice
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因為在拍賣會上取得魔法的賢者之石而忽略女友,弗林・卡森因此被命令去度假.來到紐奧良後,他卻忙於保護猶大聖杯,並試圖阻止吸血鬼威脅世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Losing his girlfriend because he was at an auction getting the magical Philosophers Stone, Flynn Carsen is ordered to take a vacation. In New Orleans he finds himself busy protecting the Judas Chalice and saving the world from vampires.

epg.programme_title_en: The Curse Of King Tuts Tomb Part 1

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1922 Cairo, archaeologist Danny Fremont races his evil nemesis to find King Tuts Emerald Tablet, the ultimate power to control-or destroy-the world. He must brave the Valley of the Kings to solve a mystery that could change history forever.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Danger swirls around the squad as they investigate a suspect for rape and try to protect their key witness. A new chief of detectives puts Benson to the test. An off-duty Fin tries to stop an assault in progress.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一名精英社交俱樂部的成員遭到襲擊時,儘管俱樂部有嚴格的保密規定,卡瑞西(Carisi)仍必須說服證人出面指證.泰南(Tynan)警長向班森提供額外協助.維拉斯科(Velasco)面臨一個意外的機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a member of an elite social club is assaulted, Carisi must convince witnesses to come forward despite the club’s strict confidentiality rules. Chief Tynan offers Benson some extra help. Velasco is confronted with a surprising opportunity.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 布魯諾(Bruno)懷疑有人安置炸彈是為了摧毀一起強姦案的 DNA 證據.班森接手了一起與爆炸案有關的謀殺調查.格里芬(Griffin)體會到辦理特別受害者小組(SVU)案件時令人沮喪的挫折感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruno suspects a bomb was planted to destroy DNA evidence in a rape case. Benson takes on a murder investigation connected to the bombing. Griffin experiences the frustrating setbacks of working an SVU case.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一名青少女因流產而面臨生命危險時,SVU 必須揭開網路編造的謊言網以辨認嫌疑人.羅林斯(Rollins)審慎評估她的職業選擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a tween suffers a life-threatening miscarriage, the SVU must unravel a web of online fabrications to identify a suspect. Rollins carefully weighs her career options.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名即將臨盆的孕婦遭到綁架,羅林斯與庫瑞(Curry)向她的陪產員尋求事件經過.卡瑞西試圖在陪審團面前取得被告的招供.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a woman in active labor is abducted, Rollins and Curry look to her doula for an account of events. Carisi tries to get a confession in front of the jury.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名即將臨盆的孕婦遭到綁架,羅林斯與庫瑞(Curry)向她的陪產員尋求事件經過.卡瑞西試圖在陪審團面前取得被告的招供.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a woman in active labor is abducted, Rollins and Curry look to her doula for an account of events. Carisi tries to get a confession in front of the jury.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小隊調查一起發生在家庭派對上的襲擊案,但現場無人能辨認攻擊者.當兩名嫌疑人被拘留審訊時,羅林斯藉機教唆他們反目成仇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The squad investigates an assault at a house party where no one can identify the assailant. When two suspects are detained for questioning, Rollins takes the chance to turn one against the other.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一名知名作家扭曲了一起嚴重犯罪的細節時,SVU 必須從幻想中辨別事實.芬在工作上度過了挑戰重重的一天.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The SVU must determine fact from fantasy when a famous author twists the details of a serious crime. Fin has a challenging day at work.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名男子聲稱其女友遭到綁架,布魯諾調查其說詞中的漏洞.泰南在一次意見分歧後對班森嚴加責難.格里芬必須在證人席上為自己的偵查工作辯護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a man claims his girlfriend was kidnapped, Bruno investigates the holes in his story. Tynan comes down hard on Benson after a disagreement. Griffin must defend his policework on the stand.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對謀殺嫌疑人的追捕揭開了一起具有震驚法律與倫理影響的犯罪.布魯諾在突襲嫌疑人住所時必須保護他的隊員.當布萊迪(Brady)的審訊手段損害案件時,卡瑞西與普萊斯(Price)在法庭上聯手應對.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The hunt for a murder suspect uncovers a crime with shocking legal and ethical implications. Bruno must protect his squad during a raid on a suspect’s home. Carisi and Price team up in court when Brady’s interrogation tactics undermine the case.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 10
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起針對德高望重法官的暗殺企圖,與上傳到 SVU 檢舉熱線的匿名影片有關.羅林斯試圖幫助一名受害者接受並面對其曾遭虐待的事實.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An attempt on a respected judge’s life is connected to an anonymous video posted to the SVU tip line. Rollins tries to help a victim come to terms with their abuse.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 11
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 庫瑞的兒子在二手店淘到的舊卡帶中發現了令人不安的內容,她與班森隨即對一起數十年前的失蹤案展開調查.格里芬得知了關於他父親的驚人傳聞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Curry’s son finds a disturbing cassette tape in a thrift store haul, she and Benson must investigate a decades-old missing persons case. Griffin learns a disturbing rumor about his father.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 12
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場對謀殺嫌疑人的追緝揭示了其背後震驚的法律與倫理糾葛.布魯諾在對嫌疑人住處進行搜查時必須全力保護小隊成員.卡瑞西與普萊斯在法庭上並肩作戰,應對因布萊迪審訊方式而產生的案件紕漏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The hunt for a murder suspect uncovers a crime with shocking legal and ethical implications. Bruno must protect his squad during a raid on a suspect’s home. Carisi and Price team up in court when Brady’s interrogation tactics undermine the case.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 13
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名從險境中獲救的少年哀求班森幫助她與父親團聚.卡瑞西與 CJ 針對寄養系統在缺乏足夠證據下拆散家庭的行為提出質疑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A teenager rescued from a dangerous situation begs Benson to help reunite her with her father. Carisi and CJ take the foster care system to task for separating families without sufficient proof.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一家人的嬰兒監視器接收到不明頻率,進而發現一名男童正身陷險境.格里芬採取極端手段試圖尋找男孩的下落.羅林斯發現自己與一名掠奪者單獨相處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A family discovers a young boy in grave danger when their baby monitor picks up a rogue frequency. Griffin goes to extremes to find the boy’s location. Rollins finds herself alone with a predator.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 15
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 名流影迷見面會上發生賓客襲擊事件的舉報,最終演變成一場謀殺調查.泰南向庫瑞警官提供了一個職涯機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reports of an assault by a guest at a celebrity fan convention leads to a murder investigation. Tynan presents Capt. Curry with a career opportunity.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 16
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在線索極其有限的情況下,一名接受幻覺劑輔助治療的女性找回了塵封已久的受襲記憶,SVU 隨即介入.庫瑞在 SVU 開始了新職位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With little evidence to guide them, the SVU steps in when a woman undergoing psychedelic-assisted therapy recovers a buried memory of assault. Curry starts a new position at SVU.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班森震驚地發現臥底警探維拉斯科竟處於一場性販運瓦解行動的核心.隨著更多女性被偷運進城,一名獲救的受害者懇求 SVU 營救她的妹妹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Benson is shocked to find undercover Det. Velasco at the center of a sex trafficking bust. When more women are smuggled into the city, a rescued victim begs SVU to help save her sister.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 18
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 飯店內的一起神秘死亡案件將小隊帶入職業格鬥的世界.班森試圖說服一名受害者為了朋友挺身而出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A mysterious death in a hotel leads the squad into the world of professional fighting. Benson tries to convince a victim to come forward for the sake of his friend.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名昏迷受傷的青少年被遺棄在醫院外,迫使 SVU 追查遺棄她的人.班森在接受反詰問的壓力下選擇守住受害者的秘密,因而面臨嚴重後果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An unconscious and injured teen abandoned outside a hospital sends the SVU on a search for the people who left her there. Benson faces serious consequences when she chooses to protect a victim’s secret under the pressure of cross examination.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在刑事司法系統中,尤其罪無可恕的被公認為性犯罪.在紐約市,專門調查這些惡極大罪的警探就是特案組的成員.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the criminal justice system, sexually based crimes are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of the Special Victims Unit.

epg.programme_title_en: Law  Order: Special Victims Unit S27 # 21
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在刑事司法系統中,尤其罪無可恕的被公認為性犯罪.在紐約市,專門調查這些惡極大罪的警探就是特案組的成員.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 路易的魯莽行為逼使強尼和丹尼爾回憶往事.眼鏡蛇道場學生密謀對受歡迎的孩子進行報復.米格爾對薩曼莎慢慢失去耐性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Louies reckless actions forces Johnny and Daniel to go down memory lane. The Cobra Kai students plot revenge against the popular kids. Miguel grows impatient with Samantha.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 彭德頓營附近發生一宗謀殺案,引領吉布斯與團隊來到聖地牙哥郊區一個商場,吉布斯更親自處理事件.積遜吉布斯突然造訪法蘭斯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A murder near Camp Pendleton leads Gibbs and the team to a suburban mall in San Diego, where Gibbs takes matters into his own hands. Jackson Gibbs pays Franks an unexpected visit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 吉布斯仍然沉浸在失去妻女的悲痛之中,但仍幫團隊調查一宗涉及失蹤女孩的案件.吉布斯的人生被徹底改寫的一刻,終於揭曉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Still grieving the loss of his wife and daughter, Gibbs helps the team work a case involving a missing girl. The moment that irrevocably changed Gibbs life is revealed.

epg.programme_title_tc: 波士頓執法尊家 (第一季) #20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 波士頓執法尊家是長壽熱門劇集執法尊家的外傳故事.華柏將再度飾演紐約警局警員丹尼雷根,而這次他將調職到波士頓警局.抵達波士頓後,他隨即與警探莉娜彼得斯成為拍檔,而莉娜則是一個著名執法世家的長女.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In BOSTON BLUE, a universe expansion of the long-running top drama BLUE BLOODS, Wahlberg will reprise his role as NYPD officer Danny Reagan as he takes a position with Boston PD. Once in Boston, he is paired with detective Lena Peters, the eldest daughter

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 知名每日謎題編輯在年度填字遊戲錦標賽被殺,艾絲比潛入解謎精英的世界,找出將為爭勝而不惜代價的冠軍選手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The brilliant yet unconventional attorney-turned-consultant ELSBETH returns for a third season with fresh cases, new characters and unexpected challenges for her and the 11th Precinct, led by her boss, Captain C.W. Wagner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍妮古柏醫生(莎蓮達史旺飾)因丈夫英年早逝,生活天翻地覆,她改變自己的職業重心,成為多倫多新上任的死因裁判官.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Still grieving the loss of his wife and daughter, Gibbs helps the team work a case involving a missing girl. The moment that irrevocably changed Gibbs life is revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: 20-Squad races to find a missing child who was abducted from her front yard. Also, Hicks is faced with a difficult decision concerning Gamble.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immediately after arriving in Artemis Academy, Seth decides to take part in the ceremony welcoming new residents to the city. However, the founder of the academy, Master Lord Majesty, ends up saddling him with a certain immense penalty.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Robot and Darlene attempt to take down the Deus group as Elliot remains unstable. Price faces off with Whiterose. Whiterose tries to manipulate Elliot and Mr. Robot struggles to figure out how to help Elliot find himself.
